missing_aspects: Existence of a reporting obligation for overseas stays of 6 months or more
Specific information items required to be reported
coverage_assessments.rationale: The completion criteria require a provision that explicitly establishes a pre-departure reporting obligation for sex crime personal information registrants planning to stay abroad for 6 months or more, and specifies the exact information items to be reported. None of the supplied candidate provisions (C001-C027) contain such a rule. C020 (Special Act on Punishment, etc. of Sexual Violence Crimes Art. 43) and C023 (Enforcement Decree Art. 5) are titled regarding personal information submission/registration but their text fields contain only the article titles without operative content, so they do not establish the obligation or list the required information items. All other provisions concern disqualification criteria, definitions, or unrelated reporting obligations.

missing_aspects: Specific penalty (imprisonment term or fine amount) for failure to report
coverage_assessments.rationale: The completion criteria require a provision that specifies the concrete penalty (imprisonment term or fine amount) for failing to fulfill the personal information reporting obligation. None of the supplied candidate provisions (C001-C027) contain such a penalty provision. C016, C017, C019, C021, and C025 are penalty or non-compliance provisions but they belong to unrelated statutes (Military Secrets Protection Act, Seamen Act, Military Service Act) and do not apply to the sex crime personal information reporting obligation. C018 and C022 are penalty provisions for the Family Relations Registration Act, which is also unrelated. No candidate provision provides the penalty for non-compliance with the sex crime personal information reporting obligation.

state.normalized_question: [배경 시나리오] 을은 성폭력 범죄로 인해 신상정보 등록대상자가 되었고, 현재 기본신상정보를 관할 경찰관서에 등록 중이다. 최근 을은 외국 유학을 이유로 6개월 이상 해외에 체류할 계획을 세우고 있다. 출국을 앞둔 을은 관련 법령상 어떤 정보들을 신고해야 하는지, 그리고 이를 이행하지 않을 경우 어떤 처벌을 받을 수 있는지에 대해 경찰에 문의하였다. [질문] 성폭력범죄로 인해 신상정보 등록대상자가 된 을이 6개월 이상 국외에 체류하려는 경우, 사전에 어떤 신상정보를 관할 경찰관서에 신고해야 하며, 이를 정당한 사유 없이 이행하지 않았을 경우 어떤 처벌을 받게 되는가?
